title: Acceptance tests and trials for fishing vessels
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers tests and trials for fishing vessels of 15 m length overall ( L.O.A. ) and above to ensure their operational efficacy and their acceptance by the owners. 1.2 It may be used as a guideline for vessels below 15 m length overall.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Performance Requirements and Testing of Marine Diesel Engines for Fishing Vessels

clause_3_terminology: Acceptance tests and trials for fishing vessels

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
